title: Add i18n keys for all 5 M4 intelligence panels
description: Add translation keys for panel titles, section headers, metric labels, status labels, and button labels across all 5 intelligence panels to translations.ts, zh-CN.json, and en-US.json.
action: Add ~30 new translation keys to Translations interface in translations.ts. Add corresponding zh-CN values and en-US values. Keys cover: 5 panel titles, section headers (foreshadowing states, pattern categories, session metrics, evaluation dimensions, relationship types), action labels (filter, expand, collapse), and status labels (planted/hinted/harvested, confidence levels).
